timingInterpretation: The public version-5 initial observation includes downloads; the version-6 update includes update/network work; the version-6 warm boot uses cached images. These are unmatched cases and establish no speedup ratio or exact first paint. The separate local matched initial pair is documented in firefox-aurora-startup.json.

updateAndWarm.verification: Exact marker, fixture, original guest download and both selected profile-file hashes matched after the real update/restart and following warm reload. This does not claim bookmark/history or SQLite integrity coverage.

visualReview.review: Root reviewed the actual Firefox window and the restored fixture tab after native Firefox Reload; the exact file fixture showed Ready.

javascript.preservationLimit: This version-6 download was created after the accepted warm reload and has not itself been reload-tested; update/warm preservation covers the original version-5 download recorded above.

retainedFailures.typedNavigation: One attempt failed visually on version 5 and one on version 6. A settled version-5 retry passed. Version 6 recovered by selecting the restored first fixture tab and clicking native Firefox Reload. Cause remains unproven; typed-input reliability is not claimed fixed.

limitations: Raw phase pass records completed observation; raw visualAcceptance remains pending and this compact record separately attributes subsequent visual review to root.
One-second log polling gives observed launch markers, not exact event timestamps or first paint.
No new mobile or physical-phone validation was performed in this release gate.
Native Firefox JIT, guest Vulkan/OpenGL, hardware video decoding and physical GPU acceleration are not implemented or established by these checks.
Experimental guest Vulkan lifecycle source is excluded from the release.
